card.name: Small words in animal-related passages
card.fires_on: Small linking words (in, to, with, by, the) and mid-word pieces in passages about animals, such as rats, dogs, kittens and bees, especially where an animal is the subject or object of an action.

modes.label: Linking words after animal actions
modes.description: A preposition follows a verb whose subject or object is an animal, such as dogs, kittens or rats.
modes.example: The researcher also told the paper that dogs appear to react<< to>> eye contact -- as do babies.

modes.label: Inside veterinary terms
modes.description: The marked piece falls inside or right after a veterinary or animal-health term.
modes.example: immunosuppression is generally not used to treat hemolytic<< an>>emias.

card.writes: It suppresses feeding and feed words, so it steers the model away from predicting feed-related words after animal text.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in texts about pets and animals and holds back words about feeding.
